89033: A first-year high school student, he has the power to summon or seal Phantoms by drawing them in a sketchbook. Haruhiko keeps a massive library in his house, and is knowledgeable on all kinds of subjects.
89034: Mai is a second-year high school student at Hosea Academy and the leader of her Phantom-hunting team.
89035: Reina Izumi is a first-year high school student who transferred to Hosea Academy in April. She has a special ability, and because of this she later joins the Phantom-Hunter club with Haruhiko Ichijou as a member of Team E.
89036: Koito Minase is a 1st-year high school student who transferred to Hosea Academy in April. Initially, instead of joining a club or fighting the phantoms together with the others, she chose to fight them alone.
89498: Kurumi Kumamakura is a 4th-year grade school student at Hosea Academy. After getting to know Haruhiko Ichijou, she joins Team E as a member of the Phantom-Hunter club.
89499: Ruru is a Phantom who accompanies Haruhiko. She is not the type of Phantom that is hunted, and is a self-proclaimed 'good girl'. Her full name is Rururaruri Rurararirararururirirari Rirararururararururararirari.
175787: A powerful phantom who can steal the abilities of ability users by kissing them and use their powers for herself. The phantom has the appearance of a young woman in dark clothing with a black hat and resembles a gunslinger from the old west.
203918: A witch-phantom who grants other phantoms wishes.
332558: A teacher at Hosea Academy. In charge of the school's Neural Error Corrections Room, thus responsible for assigning phantom hunting jobs to students with special abilities. Also a Member of the Alayashiki Research Facility.
